entities.summary: Palau is a sovereign nation in Micronesia, Oceania. Its capital is Ngerulmud (Melekeok state, since 2006). Official languages include Palauan, English. Government: Unitary presidential republic in free association with the United States. Population: approximately 0.0 million. Area: 459 km². Comprehensive index for Palau covering Micronesian settlement (~3000 BCE, among oldest in Pacific), megalithic terraces (Babeldaob), stone village platforms, Spanish claim (1574), German purchase (1899), Japanese mandate (1914-44, Nanyo-cho, major development, Japanese population exceeded Palauans), WWII (Battle of Peleliu 1944, bloodiest per capita), US Trust Territory (1947-1994), nuclear-free constitution (unique, delayed independence), Compact of Free Association 1994, marine sanctuary.
